title: Week 5 Homework 2 — RNA-seq end-to-end analysis (T4400 vs DMSO)
summary: Imported the rnaseq_course demo (24-sample mouse counts + metadata), ran DESeq2 end-to-end via EasyMultiProfiler-Web 9.0.4 plus a custom pairwise analysis across all six treatment groups. T4400 vs DMSO = 134 DEGs (76 up / 58 down); T4400+LIPUS vs DMSO = 92 DEGs (48 up / 44 down); all other contrasts vs DMSO = 0 DEGs, validating the experimental controls. Top hits converge on Wnt/β-catenin attenuation, cell-cycle withdrawal (Cdkn2d↑) and LPA signalling activation (Enpp2/ATX↑, log2FC=+1.36).
